_comment: Baseline moderate/minor a11y violation counts per <route-slug>-<mode>. Critical/serious always fail (gate is in spec, not here). Moderate/minor: spec fails if count INCREASES vs baseline; warns + suggests update if count DECREASES. Populated on first authenticated CI run, or via `npm run a11y:update-baseline`. Shape: { "<route-slug>-<mode>": { "moderate": N, "minor": N } }.
